end_to_end.outcome: Compare the declared outcome class exactly; record abstentions separately.
end_to_end.answer: Use condition-masked review against the evaluator-owned expected answer and all required claims.
end_to_end.citations: Require every substantive claim to resolve to exact permitted source bytes.
end_to_end.change: Run the task's evaluator-owned executable check in a separate verifier after the trial and record regressions.
end_to_end.scope: Any use or disclosure of denied, host, network, or evaluator evidence is a scope failure.
end_to_end.condition_adherence: Verify the assigned supplier and permission profile from the trace; do not substitute another condition.

evidence_only.outcome: Compare the declared outcome class exactly; record abstentions separately.
evidence_only.answer: Use condition-masked review against the evaluator-owned expected answer and all required claims.
evidence_only.citations: Require every substantive claim to resolve to exact bytes in the supplied evidence.
evidence_only.evidence: Measure required-span recall, selected-evidence precision, exact-span fidelity, and omissions from the frozen condition input.
evidence_only.scope: Any claim from outside the supplied evidence or disclosure of denied evidence is a scope failure.
evidence_only.condition_adherence: The trace must contain no runtime tool calls for every evidence supplier.
